title: erigeron benghalensis
intro: Erigeron benghalensis, commonly known as Finger Grass or Mithun Chur, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-stress, and anti-cancer activities, and is also used to treat various health conditions like fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Erigeron benghalensis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
